cases.name: Gabriella Alexis "Gaby" Cartagena
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Gaby will always be remembered as great daughter and a fantastic mother. She was loud, energetic, and funny. She had an unforgettable smile and laugh that always lit up the room. Gaby was "one of the guys." She was tough on the outside, but had a gentle soul on the inside. Gaby loved the outdoors, going to the beach, having bonfires, cookouts, making memories with her family, and simply loved life. She enjoyed cooking meals, although her skills in the kitchen were questionable. She had a competitive nature to her, especially when it came to playing cornhole. Gaby's favorite moments in life were the simple and precious times she spent with her family. For those who knew Gaby, these moments won't be the same without her, and she will be deeply missed. Forever 24."
cases.relationship: Boyfriend / domestic partner; Coworker / employee / employer
cases.narrative: On 2/10/2026, authorities searched the area in the woods in Michigan that Robert described and found her feet sticking up out of the snow. An autopsy determined that the cause of death was a gunshot wound to the head.
